prompt: /deep-research List all of the romance books released in 2023, that were in the top 10 most sold fiction books in Canada by print sales volume, and who appeared on the New York Times "Combined Print & E-Book Fiction" list for more than 20 consecutive weeks in the same year.
instruction: List all of the romance books released in 2023, that were in the top 10 most sold fiction books in Canada by print sales volume, and who appeared on the New York Times "Combined Print & E-Book Fiction" list for more than 20 consecutive weeks in the same year.
answer:
Based on the deep research across all three data sources, here is the complete answer:

---

## Answer

**Only one book meets all three criteria:**

| Title | Author | Canadian 2023 Rank | NYT Consecutive Weeks (2023) | Publication Date | Romance Classification |
|-------|--------|-------------------|------------------------------|------------------|------------------------|
| **Fourth Wing** | Rebecca Yarros | **#3** | **33 weeks** (Jun 18 – Dec 31, 2023) | **May 2, 2023** | Fantasy Romance / Romantasy (BISAC: Fantasy Romance; Author website; Amazon/B&N/Indigo Romance shelves) |

---

## Verification of Criteria

### 1. Canadian Top 10 Fiction Bestsellers 2023 (Print Sales) — BookNet Canada [1]
| Rank | Title | Author |
|------|-------|--------|
| 1 | It Starts with Us | Colleen Hoover |
| 2 | It Ends with Us | Colleen Hoover |
| **3** | **Fourth Wing** | **Rebecca Yarros** |
| 4 | Homecoming | Kate Morton |
| 5 | The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo | Taylor Jenkins Reid |

*Source: BookNet Canada "Bestselling books of 2023" (Dec 14, 2023) — SalesData national print tracking [1]*

### 2. NYT Combined Print & E-Book Fiction — >20 Consecutive Weeks in 2023 [2]
| Title | Author | Consecutive Weeks | 2023 Run |
|-------|--------|-------------------|----------|
| It Ends with Us | Colleen Hoover | ~37+ | Jan 1 – Sep 17 |
| It Starts with Us | Colleen Hoover | ~45+ | Jan 1 – Nov 12 |
| **Fourth Wing** | **Rebecca Yarros** | **33** | **Jun 18 – Dec 31** |

*Source: Archived NYT weekly lists via Wayback Machine (13 lists sampled Jan–Dec 2023) [2]*

### 3. 2023 Publication Date & Romance Classification [3]
- **Fourth Wing**: Published **May 2, 2023** (Red Tower Books / Entangled) — classified as Fantasy Romance / Romantasy by BISAC, author website, and all major retailers [3]
- *It Ends with Us* (2016) and *It Starts with Us* (2022) — **fail publication date**
- *Iron Flame* (Nov 7, 2023) — 2023 release, Canadian #9, but only **6 weeks** on NYT in 2023 (too new) [3]
- *Meet Me at the Lake* (May 2, 2023) — 2023 release, Canadian #10, but **~15–18 weeks** on NYT (fell short of 20) [3]
- *Homecoming* (Apr 2023) — 2023 release, Canadian #4, but historical fiction (not romance) and no 20-week NYT run
- *Icebreaker* (Aug/Nov 2022), *Lessons in Chemistry* (Apr 2022), *Verity* (Dec 2018), *Seven Husbands* (Jun 2017) — **fail publication date**

---

## Conclusion

**Fourth Wing by Rebecca Yarros** is the **sole 2023 romance novel** that simultaneously:
1. Ranked in Canada's top 10 fiction bestsellers by 2023 print sales volume (#3)
2. Spent **more than 20 consecutive weeks** on the NYT Combined Print & E-Book Fiction list in 2023 (33 weeks)
3. Was **published in 2023** (May 2, 2023)
4. Is **definitively classified as romance** (fantasy romance/romantasy)
